baseline_assumptions.peak_volume: A mid-tier UK commercial bank processing c. 50-100 new merchant applications per week. Peak following merchant acquisition campaigns: 200/week.
baseline_assumptions.onboarding_timeline: Target: 5-10 working days application to go-live for standard merchants. High-risk MCC: 10-15 working days.
baseline_assumptions.data_residency: All merchant data stored in UK. PCI DSS cardholder data never stored by the bank — handled by acquiring processor.

latency.notes: Application form submission is sub-second. KYC/AML screening involves external vendor calls (ComplyAdvantage, Companies House API) — 2-5s typical.

throughput.notes: Much lower throughput than retail journeys. Bottleneck is manual UBO verification, not system capacity.

availability.degraded_mode: If KYC vendor unavailable, application queued for up to 4 hours.

data_classification.sensitivity: HIGH — corporate and director personal data under UK GDPR and MLR 2017.

regulatory_sla.obligation: CDD must be completed before business relationship established (MLR 2017 Reg 27). Sanctions screening real-time (GOV-005-R02).

latency.notes: Credit assessment involves Companies House data retrieval, credit bureau checks on directors, and MCC risk profile analysis. Automated for standard MCCs; manual review for high-risk MCCs.

availability.degraded_mode: If credit bureau unavailable, assessment deferred with merchant notification.

data_classification.sensitivity: HIGH — credit assessment data. Director credit bureau data is personal data.

regulatory_sla.obligation: No specific regulatory SLA. Bank policy: credit assessment complete within 2 working days of KYC clearance.

latency.notes: PCI DSS level determination is instant (based on volume). SAQ review takes 1-3 working days. ROC review for Level 1 merchants may take longer.

availability.degraded_mode: PCI DSS assessment is a document review process; system unavailability has limited impact.

data_classification.sensitivity: MEDIUM — PCI DSS compliance data. Not personal data but commercially sensitive.
data_classification.retention: Duration of merchant relationship plus 3 years per scheme rules.

regulatory_sla.obligation: PCI DSS v4.0 compliance mandatory before processing live transactions. 90-day provisional acceptance permitted for new merchants.

latency.notes: Approval is a manual review step (1 working day). Scheme registration with Visa/Mastercard takes 1-2 working days via the acquiring processor.

availability.degraded_mode: Scheme registration depends on Visa/Mastercard availability. Bank retries automatically.

data_classification.retention: Duration of merchant relationship plus 7 years.

regulatory_sla.obligation: No specific regulatory SLA. Visa/Mastercard scheme rules require registration before live processing.

latency.notes: Physical terminal delivery: 3-5 working days. API credentials for e-commerce: 1 working day.

availability.degraded_mode: Terminal provisioning system must be available during business hours. Go-live confirmation is automated.

data_classification.sensitivity: HIGH — API credentials and settlement account details are sensitive.
data_classification.retention: Duration of merchant relationship plus 7 years.

regulatory_sla.obligation: PSR MR22/1.7 requires transparent pricing disclosure before go-live. Interchange++ pricing must itemise interchange, scheme fees, and acquirer margin.
references: PSR Card Acquiring Market Review remedies

end_to_end_journey_sla.description: Standard merchant onboarding: application to go-live within 10 working days. High-risk MCC: 15 working days.

audit_and_logging.all_phases: All decisions logged to SVC-103. Approval decisions and scheme registrations logged to SVC-111 WORM store.

resilience_and_recovery.description: RPO 1 hour, RTO 4 hours. Merchant onboarding is not an IBS but is revenue-critical.
